checkpoint: P2 application fill/cancel, Aethel receivable and enrolled native facility verification
source_match: Every final manifest entry matches its isolated local source bytes. The application run precedes only the three native facility source changes covered by the second run.
changes: Application reserve scopes bind the complete PQ committee digest and canonical FROST package. Native fills and cancellations require both signatures; the base payment also requires its enrolled PQ approval. Public expiry retains its original time-driven unsigned behavior.

OCLOB collaborative settlement pins both committees before state, carries the proof committee in the actual proof/certification flow, and writes/loads its explicit public enrollment file during native bootstrap.

Aethel receivable instructions carry a canonical PQ context approval; the application host builds its verifier from the governance-enrolled DeFMI record. No foundation-to-application dependency is introduced.

Archived fill recovery verifies both cryptographic components without treating the instruction deadline or current clock as execution time. This integrity-only API returns no VerifiedApplicationFill. Actual VM/facility execution checks live key validity.

Native facility product settlement builds its verifier from the venue/admission-epoch record, requiring PQ approval even when the supplied venue only allows classical signatures. Record identity, validity, widths and three-of-seven enrollment are enforced.

verification.checks: Format plus all-target Clippy -D warnings for OCLOB node/settlement/demo, DeFMI VM/core/SDK, Aethel zkPI/host and zkPI. The native facility follow-up repeats affected core Clippy and its complete facility test file.
verification.negative_cases: Missing/corrupt/classical-only signatures, fewer-than-threshold or duplicate approvers, epoch/scope substitution, invalid base-payment PQ approval, expiry before new execution, archive corruption, and absent registered native verifier. VM serialized state and native facility state root remain unchanged after rejection.
verification.evidence_limits: Deterministic real-cryptography tests with generated test keys. Native engine image is used for its linked dependency; no native MPC execution, chain/WAN run or performance comparison is part of this checkpoint.

remaining: The full migration remains in progress. P1 encrypted note/opening delivery still uses Ristretto DH; no post-change WAN or comparative performance gate has run.

P2 standing-pool allocation approvals and other caller-supplied reservation/release verifier paths remain to be connected. Bootstrap node keys are not yet bound to DeKYX-confirmed legal operators; authorized rotation and revocation propagation remain unfinished.
P3 credentials, issuer/status-list signatures and participant authorization remain classical. P4 governance, clearing, guarantor/collateral and cross-domain authorization still need integration.
FROST, Pedersen binding, range/anonymous proofs and TLS certificate authentication remain classical. Independent ML-DSA quorum approval does not make these primitives post-quantum.
P5 hash-based public audit proofs and P6 checkpoint/retirement/recovery gates remain open. No live Avalanche or seven-operator acceptance is claimed.
Immutable dependency overlays are unpublished; no branch push, shared-main merge, deployment or ledger deletion occurred.
